additional_info.subject: Case creation notes from RC
additional_info.body:
charger MP/R0170002820 was reported as having one outlet not working for 5 months. I found the charger to be very slow on my arrival (delay when using the hmi)
I rebooted the charger and completed firmware updates and couldn't find any issues with DC1 and DC2. (charger was working correctly)
This charger is at Manchester Airport and has very poor internet connection.
